recent: A miniature clockwork amusement display on a bright indoor market counter, before the shutters open — She resets a tiny brass marble-run gate with a small hand key, testing whether a smooth fluoropolymer-lined chute releases each bead cleanly

A quiet little shadow-puppet theatre before opening, sunbeams falling through its open roof lantern — She aligns a small prism in a wooden lamp bracket to turn one white stage beam into several soft colours on an unlettered paper screen

A bright indoor hydrotherapy training pool with a high wide tiled exit ledge and neatly stacked buoyancy pads — At the end of her own swimming practice, she steps from the shallow pool onto the raised exit ledge while lifting a broad foam exercise pad to stack it

A quiet rooftop camping deck with a tiny portable griddle and a compact folding table under morning sky — She slides a perfectly released little pancake from a nonstick griddle onto a plate, amused by how nothing clings to it; a single banded fluorite pebble weights a plain napkin

An outdoor ice-carving demonstration courtyard after the public demonstration, in bright winter sunlight — She clears harmless loose ice shavings from the low wooden platform with a broad hand brush while kneeling beside her finished small abstract ice sculpture

An open-air bouldering practice terrace at the edge of a small town, with low sandstone blocks and a shoe-repair bench — She threads a replacement lace through a climbing shoe after testing its grip; the other shoe rests on the bench
a temple or shrine in her element's kingdom — sitting on the ground
a mine gallery of rough rock walls — sitting on the ground
a hilltop observatory with its dome open to a clear night sky — standing
an inn or tavern of her element's kingdom at night — standing
a training gym with a heavy bag — dries her hair with a towel
a night river covered with floating paper lanterns — brings a small bouquet up to her face to smell the flowers
a glass and pottery workshop with a glowing kiln — holds a small glass jar of clear oil at chest height
